summary: [FE][MT] Verify Shutdown Logic Edit by Gantt Table, Edit by Modal and Gantt Copy and Paste convert a Deck value to the Master Data spelling, truncate or refuse the 31st character, and Y `a` becomes `A`
description_wiki:
*Scenario:* Checks that Edit by Gantt Table, Edit by Modal and Gantt Copy and Paste in Shutdown Logic change the Deck value to the Master Data spelling and limit it to 30 characters.

*Precondition:* A user with View Worklist permission (see [Role & Permission|https://pttep.sharepoint.com/:x:/r/sites/TurnaroundManagement/Shared%20Documents/03%20Development/Role%20%26%20Permission%20V.2.xlsx?d=wa5e5a9a2071b4ed7b3ef83c4cf0dffd9&csf=1&web=1&e=3stFwC]) is logged in. {{Main Deck}} is a Master Data Deck value. Worklist {{WL-A}} holds {{WK-1a}} and {{WK-1b}} with Deck {{Helideck}}, and {{WK-18g}} with Deck {{Helideck}} and Y {{B}}. The test runs for each of these rows (edit way, typed value): Edit by Gantt Table on {{WK-1a}}, {{main deck}}; Edit by Modal on {{WK-1b}}, {{MAIN deck}}. The 31-character value is {{Deck-0123456789-0123456789-ABCD}}. The texts {{main deck}}, {{a}} and {{Deck-0123456789-0123456789-ABCD}} are ready to copy.

*Navigation Path:* Planning tab > Plan Card > Worklist item > Worklist page of {{WL-A}}; Shutdown Logic > View Shutdown Logic.
